Subject: Intro/demo: Inference pilot for Aperture Health

Hi Hannah / Connor,

Thanks for the intro — Aperture is evaluating inference options for routing and triage. We would like a short demo next week to understand how Redwood handles latency and cost tradeoffs for our use case (500–1k concurrent users, PII controls required).

Proposed time: Wed Oct 6 at 11:00 AM PT. That should give our product lead (Michael) time to join.

Would 30–40 minutes work? High-level asks:
- Short demo (20m) focused on throughput/latency and deployment options
- Quick Q&A on compliance/KMS
- Next steps (trial or pilot scope)

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Chen
Head of Product, Aperture Health
laura.chen@aperture.co

Quick update and sorry for the short notice: we’ve had an internal roadmap sync this morning and leadership reallocated Infra and ML capacity to a different urgent initiative for the quarter. Several folks who were going to own the pilot are traveling for the next few weeks and there’s a hiring freeze that affects bandwidth.

If helpful, keep the MAP and any materials on file — I’ll re-open when we have a clearer timeline. Apologies again, and thanks for being flexible.
